recipe.visualDefinition: A low-key, close-up portrait of a man with long wavy hair and a beard, dominated by a harsh red light source from the left. The image features heavy film grain, dust scratches, and a soft green-tinted bokeh light in the dark background, with bilingual text placed in the bottom right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast red illumination against deep black shadows
Complementary relationship between red skin tones and green-tinted background elements
Textual anchor in the bottom right balancing the heavy visual weight of the hair on the right
coreInvariants: Heavy analog film grain and dust texture
Monochromatic red light casting deep shadows on the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, filling the upper two-thirds of the frame with a tight head-and-shoulders crop.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brightly lit red face acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the illuminated face, move down the neck, and settle on the small text in the bottom right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the subject, particularly in the lower left and upper corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep Red (primary lighting and skin tones)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale Green/Cyan (bokeh light and text highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red channel with very low value (brightness) in the surrounding environment.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to red, black, and muted teal/green

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes
Traditional calligraphic proportions for Arabic script

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over a subtle green light flare

treatment.fill: Gradient from white to pale red

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bilingual vertical stack with the non-Latin script on top.

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast and elegant serifs match the delicate feel of the text.
Standard Naskh proportions that pair well with classical serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a man with long dark wavy hair and a beard, lit by a single intense red light from the side. The background should be black with a soft green bokeh circle. Apply heavy film grain and white dust scratches.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small bilingual text stack in the bottom right corner using a light-weight serif font for the bottom line (lowercase) and a traditional Arabic font for the top line. Apply a subtle red-to-white gradient to the text.

verificationChecks: Is the red light the primary source of illumination?
Is the film grain and dust texture visible across the entire frame?
Is the text small and tucked into the bottom right corner?
Does the Arabic text sit directly above the Latin text?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between red highlights and black shadows.
Ensure the grain does not look like digital noise.
Verify the text is legible but unobtrusive.
Confirm the green bokeh provides a subtle color counterpoint.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-contrast monochromatic lighting with heavy analog textures and minimal, high-contrast serif typography for a cinematic, moody portrait aesthetic.
